blockingFindings.title: Legacy unit test constructs an invalid v2 manifest
blockingFindings.issue: The added `returns integration-gate recovery for a baseline-bearing legacy v2 fingerprint` test creates `LegacyRepairFingerprintManifest` from `current.toJSON()` while only changing `version` to 2. That object still carries the v3 `hash`, but `LegacyRepairFingerprintManifest` validates against the legacy v2 canonical parts, so construction throws before the recovery path is exercised.
blockingFindings.suggestion: In that test, build the legacy manifest with a v2 hash, for example by omitting `hash` when constructing `LegacyRepairFingerprintManifest` or by computing the legacy hash from `legacyCanonicalParts()` before writing `repair-fingerprint.json`.
blockingFindings.rationale: R5 maps to `tests/unit/flow/repair-state-identity.test.js` and requires regression coverage. This test is intended to cover the legacy v2 recovery behavior but currently fails during setup, so it blocks the mandatory acceptance coverage rather than validating the implementation.
